        if not task_data:
            return True
        for task_dict in task_data:
            task = models.Task(
                title=task_dict.get('title'),
                description=task_dict.get('description'),
                status=task_dict.get('status'),
                priority=task_dict.get('priority'),
                due_date=_as_date(task_dict.get('due_date')),
                created_at=task_dict.get('created_at'),
                updated_at=task_dict.get('updated_at'),
            )
            # Check if task already exists by title and status to avoid duplicates
            existing_task = self._repos['TaskRepository'].read_one(title=task.title, status=task.status)
            if existing_task:
                # If task exists, update it with new data
                self._repos['TaskRepository'].update(
                    id=existing_task.id,
                    title=task.title,
                    description=task.description,
                    status=task.status,
                    priority=task.priority,
                    due_date=task.due_date,
                    created_at=task.created_at,
                    updated_at=task.updated_at,
                )
            else:
                # Otherwise, create a new task
                task_id = self._repos['TaskRepository'].create(
                    title=task.title,
                    description=task.description,
                    status=task.status,
                    priority=task.priority,
                    due_date=task.due_date,
                    created_at=task.created_at,
                    updated_at=task.updated_at,
                )
                # If create returns a value, assign it to task.id
                if task_id is not None:
                    task.id = task_id
        return True

task_data = []
        if file_path:
            with open(file_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as handle:
                try:
                    task_data = json.load(handle)
                except json.JSONDecodeError:
                    raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError("Invalid JSON format")
        errors = self.validate_and_import_tasks(task_data)
        if errors:
            raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError(", ".join(errors))
        created_count = 0
        for task_item in task_data:
            task_item = task_item.copy()
            if not task_item.get('title'):
                raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError("Task.title is required")
            if not task_item.get('status'):
                raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError("Task.status is required")
            if not task_item.get('priority'):
                raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError("Task.priority is required")
            due_date = task_item.get('due_date')
            if due_date and due_date < datetime.date.today():
                raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError("Due date cannot be in the past")
            # Convert due_date to date if it's a string
            if due_date and isinstance(due_date, str):
                try:
                    task_item['due_date'] = _as_date(due_date)
                except ValueError:
                    raise errors.MissingRequiredFieldError("Invalid due date format")
            # Create task with current timestamp
            created_at = datetime.datetime.now()
            updated_at = created_at
            # Check if task with same title and status already exists
            existing_task = self._repos['TaskRepository'].read_one(title=task_item['title'], status=task_item['status'])
            if existing_task:
                # Update existing task
                self._repos['TaskRepository'].update(
                    id=existing_task.id,
                    title=task_item['title'],
                    description=task_item.get('description'),
                    status=task_item['status'],
                    priority=task_item['priority'],
                    due_date=task_item.get('due_date'),
                    updated_at=updated_at
                )
                created_count += 1
            else:
                # Create new task
                self._repos['TaskRepository'].create(
                    title=task_item['title'],
                    description=task_item.get('description'),
                    status=task_item['status'],
                    priority=task_item['priority'],
                    due_date=task_item.get('due_date'),
                    created_at=created_at,
                    updated_at=updated_at
                )
                created_count += 1
        return created_count
